en.headline: LegCo strongly condemns US politicians over Jimmy Lai case remarks
en.dek: The Legislative Council spokesperson said the council fully supports the government in enforcing the law and rejected what it called false and smearing comments from the Congressional-Executive Commission on China.
body: The Legislative Council on Friday strongly opposed and condemned politicians on the US Congressional-Executive Commission on China for what it described as false and smearing remarks about the Jimmy Lai case made at a so-called hearing, and for threats of sanctions.

A LegCo spokesperson said the council fully supports the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government in acting according to the law and resolutely rejects malicious political manoeuvring and alarmist talk. The spokesperson emphasised that safeguarding national security is a universally recognised international practice and obligation.

The spokesperson accused the US politicians of hypocrisy and double standards, noting that the United States maintains its own strict national security legal framework while criticising Hong Kong’s lawful actions. The council urged the politicians to respect China’s sovereignty and stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs.

On the case itself, the spokesperson stated that it has nothing to do with freedom of the press, and supported the courts in conducting independent trials based on law and evidence. Attempts to intimidate Hong Kong officials and judicial officers with sanctions were also strongly condemned.

zh.headline: 立法會嚴厲譴責美國政客就黎智英案發表失實抹黑言論
zh.dek: 立法會發言人表示全力支持特區政府依法執法，並強烈反對美國「國會及行政當局中國委員會」政客藉聽證會發表失實言論及揚言制裁。
body: 立法會周五表示，強烈反對並嚴厲譴責美國「國會及行政當局中國委員會」內的政客，公然藉所謂聽證會就黎智英案發表失實及抹黑言論，並揚言實施制裁。
立法會發言人強調，立法會全力支持特區政府依法執法，並對一些別有用心政客的惡意挑釁政治操作及危言聳聽予以嚴厲反擊，以正視聽。發言人指出，維護國家安全是安邦定國的基石，亦是舉世公認的國際慣例與應有之義。
發言人批評美國自身擁有嚴密的國安法律體系，其反華政客卻對香港特區依法維護國家安全的正當之舉指手畫腳，偽善與雙重標準昭然若揭。立法會敦促這些政客切實尊重中國主權，立即停止以任何形式干預中國香港事務。
針對有關政客藉黎智英案對香港法治與人權抹黑詆毀，發言人直斥其罔顧事實、顛倒黑白，並支持香港特區法院依照法律及證據進行獨立審判。發言人亦對反華政客以制裁恫嚇特區官員及司法人員予以強烈譴責。
